title: Forget the Basic Concert Tee When aespa’s SYNK : COMPLæXITY Tour Merch Is Fashion You’ll Want to Wear Beyond the Show
summary: The new merch line is selling fast, with several items sold out already. Shop what's left here while stocks last.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

aespa ’s new concert merch doesn’t just complete an outfit; it is the outfit. The group is currently on their SYNK : COMPLæXITY tour across North America through Oct. 11, before heading to Europe in 2027, but its accompanying merch collection is making just as much of a statement. It goes well past the expected concert tee, offering jewelry, bags , tattoo stickers , mirrors , metal cases , photos and trading cards alongside its fashion pieces.

shop full collection here

With 56 items split between the SYNK : COMPLæXITY tour merch and the Lemonade album line, there is plenty to browse beyond a stack of branded shirts and hoodies. The clothing leans heavily into grunge and street style, with distressed details, oversized silhouettes and designs that feel pulled from current fashion rather than a merch table. These are pieces that can easily live in an everyday wardrobe, making them feel less like souvenirs from a show and more like a way to carry aespa’s aesthetic with you long after the lights go down.

aespa has had a major year, with the release of Lemonade , the band’s second full-length album, in May and the launch of the SYNK : COMPLæXITY world tour in August. The album became the group’s eighth million-seller after surpassing 1.03 million copies in South Korea and reached No. 9 on the Billboard 200 .

The tour has also introduced new solo songs from Karina, Winter, Giselle and Ningning, which were first performed during the Seoul shows and are now being released digitally. After North America, aespa will continue through Europe in January and February 2027, closing the tour in Paris.
